summary: Iteration 4 — full validation of NEW features (coupons, referrals) + regression. Backend: 32/32 pytest PASS (17 legacy + 15 new). New backend file /app/backend/tests/test_coupons_referrals.py covers: GET /api/coupons/validate (INFLOW20 purchase ok/topup rejected, BIENVENIDA10 topup ok, invalid code, unauth 401), POST /api/wallet/purchase/{id} with coupon (discount math, one-use-per-user reuse blocked with 'Ya usaste este cupón', invalid coupon rejected), POST /api/wallet/topup with BIENVENIDA10 (bonus=5 on 50, balance=55, both topup + bonus transactions logged), referrals (signup w/ valid ref gives $5 welcome, invalid ref does not break signup, /api/referrals/me returns code/total_referred/list, purchase by referred user credits 10% commission to inviter + creates 'referral' transaction), admin coupons CRUD (users 403, duplicate code 400, percent 0/150 rejected, PATCH toggles active flag which makes /coupons/validate reject, DELETE removes). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: (1) /?ref=CODE saves inflow_ref to localStorage AND when header-login-btn opens auth-dialog it auto-switches to register mode with auth-referral-input PRE-FILLED with the code; registering yields header-balance $5.00. (2) Topup $10 -> $15. (3) Products page — buying '500 Likes Instagram' opens purchase-dialog; entering INFLOW20 + coupon-apply-btn shows coupon-applied, purchase-discount '−$1.00' and purchase-total '$4.00' (20% off $5); purchase-confirm-btn charges and header-balance updates to $11.00. (4) Insufficient balance flow: buying Pack Growth Pro ($99) with $11 shows purchase-insufficient and the confirm button reads 'Cargar saldo' and navigates to /cargar-saldo when clicked. (5) TopUp with BIENVENIDA10: topup-coupon-apply-btn reveals topup-bonus-summary ('Cargas $50.00 · Bono BIENVENIDA10 (+10%) +$5.00 · Recibes $55.00'); after submit header-balance went from $11 to $66 (=11+50+5). (6) /referidos: referral-code, referral-link, copy-code-btn, copy-link-btn, share-whatsapp, share-x, share-instagram, referral-count, referral-earnings all visible; no-referrals empty-state shows for the fresh inviter (invitee list was for a different account). (7) /mi-cuenta -> account-referrals-btn -> /referidos navigation works. (8) Admin coupons CRUD via UI: created UI-random coupon (percent 25, scope=purchase), row shows in admin-coupons-list; coupon-toggle-<CODE> toggled, coupon-delete-<CODE> removed row + toast 'Cupón eliminado'. No console page errors during any flow.
action_items: (Carryover) storage put_object/get_object use blocking `requests` inside async handlers — use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
(Carryover) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; app uses Bearer tokens so either set allow_credentials=False or specify explicit origins.
(New minor) /api/wallet/purchase does NOT check that the referrer_id is a valid ObjectId — if a doc has a legacy string, ObjectId(referrer_id) would crash. Consider guard.

(New minor) Referral commission is paid on discounted total (fine), but there's no cap or protection against self-referral if a user manually seeds referred_by to their own id. Not exploitable via public API today, but worth a guard in register().
(UX) share-instagram button copies the link to clipboard (Instagram has no share url) — consider a toast confirming the copy so users know.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~610 lines and mixes storage, auth, products, wallet, coupons, referrals — split into routers/*.py modules; also splits are needed on the frontend Admin.js which is now hosting both product and coupon CRUD (>350 lines).

get_valid_coupon raises HTTPException inside a helper — good; but the coupon match is case-insensitive on lookup (upper) yet SCOPE_LABELS keying assumes lowercase scope from client; validate scope input to be one of ('purchase','topup','both').
Coupon redemption + user balance update are not in a transaction (Mongo session) — a crash between insert_one(redemption) and inc(balance) leaves inconsistent state. For MVP OK but flag as follow-up.
Referral commission $inc is not gated on inviter still existing/active — if the inviter is deleted, commission goes to a stale id.

Purchase uses `data: Optional[PurchaseInput] = None`; FastAPI will still require a JSON body by default with 422 when Content-Type is application/json and body is empty — non-coupon purchases from frontend send `{}` (verified), so fine, but call this out in docs.
test_credentials: Admin admin@inflowmkt.com / InflowAdmin2026 verified. New users register dynamically with Test1234. Seed coupons INFLOW20 (20%, purchase) and BIENVENIDA10 (10%, topup) both work.
